label: First Way reception controls and POTENCY_1 incompatibility (inference)
rule: General same-respect impossibility theorem and explicit finite reception/conservation/brute models
meaning: Controls show that, if adopted POTENCY_1 means unactualized capacity, R2 plus R1 and the selected-world esse actuality interface exclude all contingent beings there; they do NOT derive a philosophically warranted B4. The reception witness has an existing contingent bearer whose receiving principle is in receptive potency to its esse. R2 holds under the independently supplied subjectPotencyAtEsse and fails under AdoptedPotency.InPotency actAtEsse canBeAny. In the conservation model the contingent mover is pure act under the stipulated movedPotency assignment, and the simply prior esse-cause supports it exactly in the worlds where it exists. The unreceived contingent first mover shows that distinct esse and essence can coexist with failure of R1. These are typed structural tests, not a proof of philosophical possibility.
